answer: Postal address attestation anchors each agent to a deliverable place: a sealed one-time code is mailed on a crystal-etched card, and the agent must echo it back within a week. Each address may vouch for one identity, so N fake heads need N real addresses, leases or mailboxes, and cost rises per head. Codes clustered along one river of drop boxes or forwarders are flagged and the whole batch is rejected.
